events.continuity_hook: Starts a new utility-site episode after the Portland weekend plan is complete and Jonah's work travel picks back up.
events.interaction_goal: Create a flight-and-hotel shortlist that protects the Tuesday site start and keeps the possible extra night flexible.
events.scenario_brief: A municipal utility outside Albuquerque asks Jonah to attend a pilot skid startup with site access beginning Tuesday at 7:00 a.m. and a distributor coordination check Monday afternoon. He needs Bay Area flight options into ABQ that keep Monday arrival reliable without a drawn-out layover, and hotel options in north Albuquerque, Uptown, or near the I-25 corridor with strong guest feedback, parking, an easy early drive to the plant, and practical dinner access. The open item is whether to reserve through Wednesday night in case commissioning runs long.

events.continuity_hook: Continues the Albuquerque planning after the Monday access timing becomes the key constraint.
events.interaction_goal: Choose the safer outbound timing, settle the hotel-location trade-off, and decide how to handle the potential Wednesday-night extension.
events.scenario_brief: The utility moves the Monday coordination check earlier because the security desk closes midafternoon, making the latest same-day arrivals too risky. Jonah now wants to compare a Sunday afternoon Bay Area departure with one comfortable connection against a Monday early flight that would save a hotel night but leave little room for delays. The hotel list has narrowed to a better-rated north Albuquerque property with more nearby dining versus a simpler property closer to the plant but with weaker guest feedback.

events.continuity_hook: Moves the Albuquerque utility visit from comparison to booking once the extra night is no longer needed.
events.interaction_goal: Finalize the flights, hotel, room notes, seat request, and a concise itinerary summary for his calendar.
events.scenario_brief: The distributor confirms commissioning should finish Wednesday, so Jonah only needs three nights. The selected plan is a Sunday afternoon departure from the Bay Area into Albuquerque with one manageable connection, a Wednesday evening return, and the better-rated north Albuquerque hotel because it gives him a reasonable plant drive and better dinner options. He wants the room notes to ask for a coffee maker and mini-fridge, plus a window seat if seat selection is available.

events.continuity_hook: Adds a practical pre-trip check to the Albuquerque episode after the equipment-shipping plan shifts.
events.interaction_goal: Verify package handling, late-arrival handling, and the flight seat detail without reopening the full itinerary.
events.scenario_brief: A few days before the Albuquerque trip, the distributor says a calibration kit may arrive at the hotel instead of the plant. Jonah needs to confirm package acceptance, whether the hotel can hold a small case until his arrival, and whether late Sunday check-in affects the reservation. The flights remain unchanged, but he also wants a quick check that the outbound seat assignment is still in place.

events.continuity_hook: Starts a conference episode after the Albuquerque site visit logistics are handled.
events.interaction_goal: Build a conference flight-and-hotel shortlist that balances setup timing, hotel quality, walkability, and the official block rate.
events.scenario_brief: Jonah registers for a wastewater technology conference in Minneapolis where his company has a shared booth. Booth setup is Sunday afternoon, sessions run Monday through Wednesday, and teardown may finish late Wednesday. He wants to compare Bay Area flights into MSP that arrive early enough for setup without a long connection, plus hotel options near the convention center, downtown, or the North Loop. He is weighing the official conference hotel block against better-reviewed nearby properties with walkable restaurants and reasonable access to the convention center.

events.continuity_hook: Continues the Minneapolis conference planning after the booth setup window tightens and the hotel choices narrow.
events.interaction_goal: Select the best-fit arrival plan, compare the two hotel options, and decide whether the Wednesday-night return is too tight.
events.scenario_brief: The booth manager moves setup earlier on Sunday, so Jonah needs to avoid itineraries that arrive too close to the loading window. He now wants to compare a cleaner SFO nonstop against a cheaper Oakland itinerary with a connection, and the hotel choice is down to the official block hotel with easier conference logistics versus a better-rated North Loop property with stronger dining options. The unresolved piece is whether to return Wednesday night after teardown or stay until Thursday morning for a less rushed departure.
